name: JG_TAX_INVOICE_REFERENCES
description: This table contains reference information related to the tax invoice that is obtained from the tax authority. When the information (such as the tax invoice number, tax invoice date and first party registration number) is valid, the tax authority sends back an "Invoice Reference Number" and other details and references that are needed for further processing (such as shipment). In case the information sent is not valid, the tax authority sends an error code and error message.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Record identifier for the invoice.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Transaction application identifier.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity code of the transaction application event class.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Application event class of the transaction.

columns.name: TRX_ID
columns.description: Primary transaction identifier.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Invoice record type. Possible values are Outbound and Inbound.

columns.name: FIRST_PTY_REG_NUM
columns.description: First party tax registration number for the transaction.

columns.name: THIRD_PTY_REG_NUM
columns.description: Third party tax registration number for the transaction.

columns.name: TAX_INVOICE_NUMBER
columns.description: Tax invoice number for the transaction.

columns.name: TAX_INVOICE_DATE
columns.description: Tax invoice date for the transaction.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_TAX_INVOICE_NUMBER
columns.description: Original tax invoice number for the transaction.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_TAX_INVOICE_DATE
columns.description: Original tax invoice date for the transaction.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Invoice document type. Possible values are Tax invoice and Delivery challan.

columns.name: SUPPLY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of supply. Possible values are B2B for Business to Business, SEZWP for SEZ with payment, SEZWOP for SEZ without payment, EXPWP for Export with Payment, EXPWOP for Export without payment, and DEXP for Deemed Export.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Financial tax period name on the invoice.

columns.name: INVOICE_REFERENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Invoice reference number for the invoice.

columns.name: BATCH_NAME
columns.description: Request batch name of the invoice reference number generation process.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: Indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: BILL_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of bill. Possible values are Shipping bill number and E-WAY bill number.

columns.name: BILL_NUMBER
columns.description: E-WAY bill or shipping bill number.

columns.name: BILL_DATE
columns.description: E-WAY bill or shipping bill date.

columns.name: QR_CODE_RESPONSE
columns.description: QR code response for the invoice.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Invoice reference number error details.

columns.name: ACKNOWLEDGMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Acknowledgment number for the invoice reference number generation process.

columns.name: ACKNOWLEDGMENT_DATE
columns.description: Acknowledgment date for the invoice reference number generation process.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Invoice reference number status.

columns.name: ERROR_CODE
columns.description: Invoice reference number error code.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SHIPPING_REFERENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Shipping reference number for the tax invoice number or the invoice reference number.

columns.name: SHIPPING_REFERENCE_DATE
columns.description: Shipping reference date for the tax invoice number or the invoice reference number.

columns.name: SELLING_REFERENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Seller reference number for the tax invoice number or the invoice reference number.

columns.name: BUYER_REFERENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Buyer reference number for the tax invoice number or the invoice reference number.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_REFERENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Additional reference number provided by the tax authority.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_REFERENCE_DATE
columns.description: Additional reference date provided by the tax authority.

columns.name: DISPATCH_REFERENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Dispatch reference number related to the tax invoice number or the invoice reference number.

columns.name: DISPATCH_REFERENCE_DATE
columns.description: Dispatch date of the shipment related to the tax invoice number or the invoice reference number.
